full_page.content:
Baby Maureen Doyle - for speedy improvement and recovery, God willing -
Courage is half the battle - Confidence in God the soul of prayer - Foster the latter and you have both.
Father Solanus O.F.M. Cap. September 2, 1947
Praised be Jesus!
